name: renuvo-hyperframes-renderer
description: Public GitHub Actions renderer for Renuvo HyperFrames workflow-dispatch jobs.

scripts.check:example: npm run prepare:example && hyperframes check example-project --strict
scripts.render:example: npm run prepare:example && hyperframes render example-project --output renders/renuvo-day-01-local.mp4 --fps 30 --quality high --strict
